wholePhysicalScope: Mapped retaining arc, inner and outer cavea walks, axial stair and municipal archaeological measurements provide the theatre geometry. The stage deck, irregular seating and remaining columns follow the five cleared exterior images.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the horseshoe seating and high perimeter, lowered orchestra and asymmetric partial stage facade. The detailed levels refine the radial stairs, row counts, rock cuts and columns.
limitations: This is the exposed 2017 site. The partly restored stage wall and seating are represented as surviving fabric, with adjacent cathedral and museum outside scope.
The lower seating follows published dimensions. The spacing and surviving heights of the upper terraces, stage ruins and column fragments are visual estimates.
The original relief remains unchanged. Exact excavation and exposed floor heights are unavailable, so the visible archaeology and local embedment are approximate.
